trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles, and ten registrations earn this trophy. Drive a vehicle you want to keep, open the app and register it, then repeat with nine more distinct vehicles. Any vehicle you drive counts, so register the interesting ones as you discover them.
steps: Drive a vehicle you want to keep
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it
Repeat with ten different vehicles
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
